title: Mine Detector
stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Front-end and Express.js, Supabase.js)
info:
This project is a clone of the classic Minesweeper game which I created from scratch. It supports customizable board sizes and numbers of mines in addition to seeding the random number generator for repeating boards. This game was designed to be played as a Discord Activity and will store your best time against your Discord user ID for future sessions.
You can play the game on [Discord](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1462849859362230362) or view the source code on [GitHub](https://github.com/k-matta/mine_detector).
